most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Acute (hematogenous or late) prosthetic joint infection of a revision left total knee arthroplasty
one_line_reason: The swollen, warm knee is a revised total knee arthroplasty. The joint fluid has 107,500 WBC/uL with 87% neutrophils and leukocyte esterase 3+, and CRP is 143.7 mg/L. That meets prosthetic joint infection criteria, and native-joint septic arthritis, the closest listed leaf, does not fully fit a prosthetic joint.
